race.comment: EMPIRE RULER (2) sets the standard after two seconds on soft ground, most recently nabbed by Rich Melody at Strathalbyn after a slow start. With five placings this season and a solid record at this venue, he has Noel Callow aboard for four of those rides. Ready to win. NUNYA (5) poses the main threat after finishing just under a length behind at Halidon, but he's now up against tougher competition and tackling 1800m for the first time. SWAN DANCE (11) returns from a four-month break, having had two trials and sporting blinkers for the first time. She boasts the best consistency in the field, including a Class 1 third at Morphettville last campaign. EMBERANCE (8) is more experienced, having faced recent competition without placing in eleven starts, yet the 3kg claim and fourth-up fitness provide potential for improvement.
